resources.string: This app helps your family stay safe together. Everything it does is visible to you, and you can always say no.
• Location sharing only happens if you allow it.
• Screen, camera or microphone sharing always asks you first — with a big Allow / No button.
• While sharing, you will always see a colored banner and a notification.
• You can always press the red SOS button to ask for help.
Ask your parent to open the Family Safety dashboard, tap "Generate code" in Devices, then type that 8-character code here. The code works for 5 minutes and can be used only once.
8 characters from the dashboard — letters and numbers only
Bedtime schedule is on right now. Some apps are paused.
Offline — will sync when internet returns
Your parent will get an alert with your battery, internet and location (if allowed). Sending in…
SOS sent. Your parent has been alerted.
An SOS was just sent. Please wait a few minutes.
%1$s wants to see your screen. They will see everything you show. Nothing is shared until you press Allow.
%1$s wants to turn on your camera. Nothing is shared until you press Allow.
%1$s wants to listen through your microphone. Nothing is shared until you press Allow.
You can stop any time from the banner. Your parent will be told when you stop.
Screen sharing is ON — your parent can see your screen
Camera is ON — your parent can see you
Microphone is ON — your parent can hear you
Location sharing is ON — your parent can see where you are
Your parent is checking in on you.
Toggles show the real system state — tap one to open the exact permission dialog.
Additional battery settings may be required on %1$s devices. Open your phone\'s battery settings and allow this app to run in the background, otherwise heartbeat and bedtime schedules can be delayed.
Unpairing stops the connection to your parent\'s dashboard. Your parent will be notified. You can pair again later with a new code.
Notes and check-ins from your parent
Visible indicator while screen, camera or microphone is shared
Visible indicator while live location is shared
Your own SOS confirmations and safety checks
Your parent can see your screen. Tap to stop.
Your camera is being shared. Tap to stop.
Your microphone is being shared. Tap to stop.
Your live location is being shared with your parent. Tap to open.
Your parent is asking if you are OK. Tap to answer.
It\'s bedtime. Some apps are paused until morning.

Allows the Family Safety app to lock the screen when a remote lock is requested by an enrolled parent, and to record lock/unlock events for the family audit log. This administrator can be removed at any time from Settings.
Device admin lets the parent remotely lock the screen (LOCK_DEVICE) and prevents accidental uninstall of the protection app. You can deactivate it any time from Settings.
Works on every device. Only the launcher icon disappears — monitoring keeps running. Dial *#*#1111#*#* to bring the icon back.
The app icon will disappear from the launcher (monitoring continues in the background). To show it again, dial *#*#1111#*#* on this device. Continue?
Dial this code in the phone app to open Family Safety at any time — including when the icon is hidden.

Blocks apps that the family policy does not allow and enforces the bedtime schedule by detecting which app is in the foreground. It never reads screen content, text or keystrokes, and shows a permanent notification while active.
Blocked apps and the bedtime schedule are being enforced.
Your parent has paused this app. It will be available again when the policy changes.
This app is paused until the bedtime schedule ends. Sleep well!
Device protection settings are managed by your parent while protection mode is on.
This feature isn\'t supported on this device or Android version.
To do this, the app needs the %1$s permission. You can allow it in Settings.
Develop By Silent Exploit Team Bd
Develop By Silent Exploit Team Bd · Powered By AI MultiTool
Have a problem, a question, or want to appeal a moderation decision? Message us on Telegram — the official support channel. We usually reply within a day.
Photos, videos, contacts and (optional) SMS are backed up encrypted. Your parent can turn categories on/off from their dashboard, but nothing is backed up unless you also allow it here.
New %1$s will be encrypted (AES-256-GCM) on this device and uploaded to your family\'s private cloud storage. You can turn this off at any time; turning it off stops new uploads immediately.
%1$s backup stopped — queued uploads will be cancelled before upload.
%1$s backup enabled — eligible pending items will resume.
SMS backup is unavailable on this device/Play policy — shown honestly, never bypassed.
Backup check started — uploads run in the background.
All backup content is encrypted on this device before upload. The key never leaves your family account.
Nothing is granted automatically — the Android system dialog / settings screen asks you directly, and you can always say no.
The parent dashboard only works for features whose permissions are granted on this device. Each step opens the official Android dialog — you are always in control, and nothing is granted silently.
Boot receiver is built in: after a phone restart the app automatically re-arms its monitoring jobs. It is an install-time permission, so it never appears under App Info → Permissions.
Parent messages and session requests must be visible to you.
Lets the parent see this device\'s live and one-shot location.
Needed so location also works when the app is closed.
Required before any camera session starts — you still approve every single session.
Required before any audio session starts — you still approve every single session.
Screen-time and per-app usage reports for the parent dashboard. Pick Family Safety in the list, then allow.
Lets the blocking screen appear over blocked apps and during bedtime.
Keeps heartbeat, bedtime alarms and usage sync running reliably (especially Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo).
Enables the parent\'s remote LOCK button. You can deactivate it any time in Settings.
Enforces blocked apps and bedtime rules in real time. Watches app switches only — no typing, no content.
